'''ED-G4R''' was an [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was present at [[Strike Base XR-484]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Ossus}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
